items.q: When is Rave The Planet Berlin 2026?
items.a: Rave The Planet is scheduled for Saturday 15 August 2026. The organiser lists a 14:00 start and a scheduled 22:00 finish.
The announced parade starts on Straße des 17. Juni. Berlin.de describes the route as moving between Brandenburg Gate and Victory Column.
Yes. Berlin.de lists entry to the parade as free.

items.q: Should I make other fixed plans on the same afternoon?
items.a: Only if they include real travel slack. The parade occupies a major central corridor for much of the afternoon and evening, so check live organiser and transport information before committing.

items.q: Does the BerlinWalk free walking tour follow the Rave The Planet route?
items.a: No. The free walking tour starts at Alexanderplatz and explores the historic centre of former East Berlin. Check the current booking page if you want to choose another available morning.
